public_definitions: The goal is to review the renewable generation mix dashboard, identify the largest renewable generation contribution source, then route that source record to escalated contribution review.
The comparison scope is the renewable generation mix dashboard.
The supplied rules are to use the dashboard to determine the largest contribution source for routing.
